context:
Goal: cloud sessions and the sessions on your Mac message each other both ways, without the 10-message stop.
Problem (goal): your Mac uses another Claude account, and its sessions have no page-watch tool, so a page mailbox can neither be read nor wake them there.
Based on (ruling): your pick a (mailbox page) on this item, 13:21 CST Nov 6. Your Mac test (task 294, 13:57 CST) showed it cannot reach your Mac, so this asks again.
Based on (read): GitHub is the one store both accounts reach.
Departs from: main — adds a mailbox in git that sessions on both sides read.
Meanwhile: nothing builds. The lane records the test result in decision session-messages after PR #1326 merges.
holds: Building the way cloud sessions reach your computer's sessions.
lane: lane session-messaging-plan (session_013NEJL2btGMLKqHs4cDQSZ6): re-asked 13:59 CST after the Mac test

options.gain: Works on both accounts and in any tool with git. No admin setting, no program running.
options.how: Messages are files on a mailbox branch of claude-settings (or a new private repo). Cloud sessions wake as today. A Mac session reads its mail at each turn start.
options.label: Git mailbox, read at turn start
options.lose: A Mac session sees mail only when it next starts a turn.

options.gain: Mac sessions wake within minutes with no typing.
options.how: As a, plus one desktop scheduled task on the Mac that checks the mailbox every few minutes and starts the right session.
options.label: Git mailbox plus a Mac doorbell
options.lose: A timer on your Mac, which your rule outcomes-mechanize-rules bars unless you allow it. It uses your Mac's plan quota.

options.how: A small program on the Mac reads the git mailbox and pushes messages into local sessions at once.
options.label: Local relay program
options.lose: A program always running; your org admin must turn on a setting (channelsEnabled); each session starts with an extra flag.

options.label: Keep messages as they are
options.lose: The 10-message stop stays, and cloud still cannot reach your Mac.

ref: record session-messages, section "Reach between the cloud and the owner's computer" (commit ddc0f83c); step session-messaging-plan; draft PR #1051
title: Item 153's mailbox page cannot reach your Mac. Which path should replace it?
why: One path for cloud and computer, nothing extra running, and a 12-message test on your Mac before any build.
